notes.title: Small bug fix for Mac versions
notes.content: BugFix will fix UI bugs for Mac version, where buttons which are on mobile versions are being shown on Mac version.

notes.title: Minor UI elements fix
notes.content:
This update aims to fix the UI 'fire button' and 'weapon select button' which are for mobile devices and not for PC/Mac, but were shown by mistake.
The screen shown by pressing the Cog button was also showing the mobile version rather than the PC/Mac version.
